g.text: Turning models, data and APIs into tools people actually
use — shipped, measured, and improved after the first deploy.
“Ideas are cheap. Useful systems are the work.”
AI products, LLM workflows and voice interfaces

NAXATRA AI — useful AI infrastructure for Bharat
